svg.text: Only P 1xTP1 / D 1xTP1 is calibrated; every other point is extrapolated until matching measurements exist.

Vertical axes are baseline-relative percent improvement, so 0% is the calibrated reference. TP-only cases are flat under the current serving_disagg_colocated scalar cost model; worker scaling changes queueing behavior.
Output Token Throughput improvement vs baseline (%)
Total logical GPUs = prefill workers x prefill TP + decode workers x decode TP
